lessons.text: A list fed by a microflow refreshes only when a persistent context object is committed with refresh, so the carousel and the menu filters keep their state on the guest's cart.
The security report found 3 high findings no test caught: data sources that trusted an object id from the browser. Each now checks ownership or PUBLISHED.
